name: railway_service_create
description: CREATE a new service in a project (serviceCreate). Requires `projectId` (from railway_list_projects). Provide a source: EITHER `sourceRepo` (a GitHub repo, e.g. 'railwayapp/starters' or a full github.com URL) OR `sourceImage` (a Docker image, e.g. 'ghcr.io/user/app:latest') — not both. Optional `name` (defaults to something Railway picks), `branch` (for a repo source), and `environmentId` to target a specific environment. Returns the new service `{ id name projectId }`; use that id with railway_get_project / railway_list_deployments. This provisions real infrastructure — confirm the project, source, and name with the user before calling.

projectId.description: The project id to create the service in (from railway_list_projects).

sourceRepo.description: A GitHub repo to deploy from, e.g. 'owner/repo' or a github.com URL. Use this OR sourceImage.

sourceImage.description: A Docker image to deploy, e.g. 'ghcr.io/owner/app:latest'. Use this OR sourceRepo.

branch.description: Optional git branch to deploy (only meaningful with sourceRepo).

environmentId.description: Optional environment id to target (from railway_get_project).

body_defaults.query: mutation serviceCreate($input: ServiceCreateInput!) { serviceCreate(input: $input) { id name projectId } }
